name: Dialog
description: Animated native <dialog> modal; also covers Alert Dialog (persistent), Sheet (4 sides) and a mobile Drawer with swipe to close.

builder.summary: Modal, side sheet or swipeable mobile drawer

persistent.label: Must answer
persistent.help: Cannot be closed with Escape or a click outside

swipe.label: Swipe to close
swipe.help: Lets people close the panel with a swipe

useWhen: A blocking confirmation is needed before a destructive or irreversible action
A short form or detail view must stay in context without leaving the page
A side sheet must slide in from an edge for settings, filters or a cart
A detail panel must stay open beside a board or list that remains usable (modeless)
On mobile, a bottom drawer the user can swipe away fits better than a centered modal

avoidWhen.when: The message is transient feedback that shouldn't interrupt the user
The content is a small panel anchored to a trigger that shouldn't block the page
The flow has many steps or needs its own URL; use a dedicated page instead

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: Alert mode: no closing via Escape or outside click, role=alertdialog (follows later changes).

attributes.name: swipe
attributes.description: Swipe to close (sheets / drawers); can be turned on or off at any time.

attributes.name: modeless
attributes.description: Non-modal: no backdrop, no scroll lock, the page stays usable (a side panel next to a board or a list). Escape from inside closes it (unless persistent) and focus returns to the trigger. Applies at the next opening.

methods.name: show()
methods.description: Opens as a modal (or non-modal with modeless).

events.name: mv-close
events.description: detail.returnValue: value of the [data-mv-close] button, or “dismiss” / “swipe”.

slots.name: [data-mv-open]
slots.description: Internal trigger; for an external one: data-mv-open="#id".

slots.name: <dialog>
slots.description: Content; data-variant="sheet" + data-side="right|left|top|bottom". May be rendered or replaced after the element connects (Angular, a late v-if): it is looked up when needed, and a pending open applies once it exists.

cssVars.name: --mv-dialog-z
cssVars.description: Stacking of a modeless dialog (a modal one sits in the top layer).

a11y: Focus trapped and restored by the native <dialog>, inert page, Escape. With modeless, the page is not inert and focus is not trapped (Tab can leave the panel, as for any non-modal dialog); Escape inside it closes it and focus returns to the trigger. aria-labelledby/-describedby wired automatically from .mv-dialog-title / .mv-dialog-description, checked again at each opening so a title rendered late by a framework is still used.
